title: Python DODAG admission derives neighbor from mutable RxFrame after sealing
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:305-318 accepts and seals authenticated DIO evidence, then derives the neighbor from original received.sender_iid after the LinkLayer receipt transaction. object.__setattr__ or a concurrent mutation can attribute authenticated DIO state to a different neighbor. Expose sender IID on the sealed AuthenticatedDio, cover it in the LinkLayer-owned structural snapshot, and derive all post-admission identity only from sealed evidence. Add mutation and forced race regressions.
